chunks: Al-Hatim was named al-Hatim because the people crush one another there.

key_terms.النَّاسَ: the people, referring to the crowds present there
key_terms.الْحَطِيمُ: al-Hatim, the area being referred to by name
key_terms.حَطِيماً: named as Hatim; indicating the designation of the place

ai.seo_question: Why was al-Hatim given this name?
ai.summary: This report explains the naming of al-Hatim by linking it to the crowding that occurs there. It presents an etymological reason: people press and crush against one another in that place during pilgrimage.
